strings.additionalskiptables_desc: A list of tables (separated by commas) which should be skipped when running the database search and replace.
strings.cannotfit: The replacement is longer than the original and shortening is not allowed; cannot continue.
strings.disclaimer: I understand the risks of this operation
strings.excludedtables: Several tables are not updated as part of the text replacement. These include configuration, log, events, and session tables.
strings.invalidcharacter: Invalid characters were found in the search or replace text.
strings.notimplemented: Sorry, this feature is not implemented in your database driver.
strings.notsupported: This script should be considered experimental. Changes made cannot be reverted, thus a complete backup should be made before running the script!
strings.pageheader: Search and replace text throughout the whole database
strings.privacy:metadata: The DB search and replace plugin does not store any personal data.
